title: CRS-Bench: A Reference-Relative Reliability Benchmark for Medical Image Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.22059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained image encoders are central to medical image classification, where expert annotation is costly and task-specific cohorts are often limited. As the model space expands from general-purpose to broad-medical and specialty-specific encoders, selecting the representation becomes a substantive modeling decision. Clean-test discrimination alone is insufficient for this purpose: encoders with similar AUROC can differ in calibration, label efficiency, and stability under acquisition perturbations or distribution shift.   We introduce CRS-Bench, a controlled benchmark for multi-objective medical encoder selection. translated_title: CRS-Bench：医学图像编码器的参考相对可靠性基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22059v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：预训练图像编码器是医学图像分类的核心，因为专家标注成本高昂且任务特定队列通常有限。随着模型空间从通用型扩展到广泛医学型和专科特异性编码器，选择表示成为一个实质性的建模决策。仅凭干净测试的判别能力不足以满足此目的：具有相似AUROC的编码器在校准、标签效率以及获取扰动或分布偏移下的稳定性方面可能存在差异。我们引入了CRS-Bench，一个用于多目标医学编码器选择的受控基准。CRS-Bench使用ISIC 2019、APTOS 2019和CheXpert评估了15个预训练编码器系列，覆盖皮肤科、眼科和放射科，并将CheXpert到MIMIC-CXR作为观察到的机构偏移，共生成17,575条受控运行记录和3,515条种子聚合指标行。每个编码器沿四个操作维度进行特征化。
tldr: 本文提出CRS-Bench基准，通过多目标评估（包括校准、标签效率和稳定性）为医学图像编码器选择提供参考相对可靠性度量，超越了仅依赖AUROC的传统方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CRS-Bench, a benchmark that provides reference-relative reliability metrics for medical image encoder selection through multi-objective evaluation including calibration, label efficiency, and stability, going beyond AUROC alone.
